description.noProject: Generate an SBOM from a compiled artifact or container image

warnings.noProject: Please select a project first before generating an SBOM.

file.label: Binary or archive
file.hint: Executables, libraries, jars, or archives. Syft detects packages and language binaries.

path.label: Local file or directory path
path.hintBefore: Scanned in place on the server host (no upload) — use for large local artifacts and prebuilt image trees. An Android image folder (with
path.hintAfter: ) is auto-detected and unpacked (sparse → super → EROFS/ext4) before scanning; on Windows this runs via WSL2. The path must exist on the machine running the backend.

image.label: Image Reference
image.hint: Pulled directly from the registry by Syft (no Docker daemon required).
